_what: Custom voice detector (2026-10-06): the pre-registered training data and splits. Fixed in measurements/voice-detector-custom-preregistration-2026-10-06.md before any model was trained. Lists below were computed from the sources' own metadata with the stated rules; prepare.py re-derives them and refuses to run if they differ. FNV-1a = 32-bit FNV-1a over the UTF-8 bytes (scripts/realnoise-fv/lib/sets.mjs).

librispeech.rule: LibriSpeech subsets are speaker-disjoint by design; every utterance of the four subsets

vctk.rule: speaker -> val iff FNV-1a(speaker) % 10 == 0 (13 of 110: 8 F, 5 M); utterances: FNV-1a(utterance id, e.g. 'p225_001') % 10 == 0; microphone: mic1 if FNV-1a(utterance id) is even else mic2 (wav48_silence_trimmed flac)

coswara.excluded_dates_why: held-out voice sets of the notch work (build/notchvd-heldout, build/notchvd-heldout2)
coswara.rule: the 40 remaining date folders; date -> val iff FNV-1a(date) % 8 == 0 (286 of 2447 participants, 11.7 %); recordings vowel-a, vowel-e, vowel-o, counting-normal, counting-fast with the Coswara audio-quality label >= 1; participants with returning-user flag rU = y excluded (their earlier recordings cannot be linked); breathing and cough recordings are not used

mdvr_kcl.rule: subject -> val iff FNV-1a(subject id) % 5 == 0 (8 of 38); ReadText + SpontaneousDialogue recordings

train.dagstuhl_choirset: audio_wav_22050_mono/*_DYN.wav and *_HSM.wav (close dynamic and headset microphones of individual singers); takes with 'Piano' in the name excluded (piano bleed); larynx (LRX), stereo room (STM/STL/STR) and piano (SPL/SPR) tracks excluded
train.esmuc_choir: individual singer tracks (S1-S5, A1-A3, T1-T3, B1-B2); the room microphones (*_ORTF.wav, *_AB.wav) excluded

val.cantoria: Audio/Cantoria_<song>_{S,A,T,B}.wav (4 singers x 14 song parts); *_Mix.wav and *_MixOrgan.wav excluded

choir.gender_rule: voice part S / A -> f, T / B -> m (recorded as voice_part; gender derived)

fsd50k.split_why: FSD50K's dev and eval splits share no Freesound uploader (checked: 4947 vs 2297 uploaders, 0 shared)
fsd50k.licence_rule: per-clip licence CC0 1.0, CC BY 3.0 or CC BY 4.0 (CC BY-NC and Sampling+ excluded)
fsd50k.keyword_rule: clip excluded when its Freesound title, description or tags match (whole word, case-insensitive) the regex in prepare.py KEYWORDS (voice / speech / talk / sing / song / choir / chant / man / woman / people / child / crowd / laugh / shout / whisper / narration / radio / tv / podcast / interview / restaurant / party / music / melody / humming ...)

fstrain.what: Freesound HQ previews found by search-page queries for machine / room noise: the 38 query topics of the benchmark's 279-clip set (scripts/notch-adversarial/realdata/fetch_noise.py FS_QUERIES) plus 8 more; NONE of the 34 topics of held-out set B (fetch_heldout.py FS_HELD), so held-out B stays a set of machine types never trained on; pages 1-3, duration 5-900 s, at most 20 kept per query, first 120 s used
fstrain.licence_rule: licence read from the search result / sound page: CC0 or CC BY only
fstrain.split_rule: uploader in FSD50K eval -> val; uploader in FSD50K dev -> train; else FNV-1a(uploader) % 10 == 0 -> val, else train

synthetic.what: interferers generated in process, ported from scripts/noise-synth.js and scripts/notch-adversarial (vmach.mjs, r2int.mjs, int.mjs families): single and harmonic hums 40-460 Hz, 50 / 60 Hz mains complexes, fan hum over rumble, voice-like machines (harmonic stack with shared 0.5-8 Hz speed wobble, 3-10 c, sinusoidal or OU), beating pairs, AM, drift / step / spin-up ramps, intermittent switching, resonant / white / pink / brown noise, crickets / cicadas, codec birdies

negatives.reverb: synthetic shoebox room impulse responses (image method, generated in process); train / val seeds as the synthetic interferers

dedup_vs_benchmark.freesound_ids: every Freesound id in the benchmark noise manifests (noise.freesound 146 + noise.fsheld 101) and every ESC-50 source id (esc50.csv src_file, 1524 ids, all 2000 clips)
dedup_vs_benchmark.freesound_uploaders: every uploader of a benchmark Freesound preview (179 uploaders: noise.freesound + noise.fsheld)
dedup_vs_benchmark.audio_fingerprint: every remaining negative clip is fingerprinted against every clip of the benchmark noise manifests (freesound, fsheld, mssnsd, demand, esc50, dcase, dcaseeval): a clip whose fingerprint matches (bit error rate <= 0.35 over an aligned 3 s block, or the whole shorter clip) is dropped
dedup_vs_benchmark.speech_screen: every negative clip is screened with Silero VAD v6.2.3 (16 kHz, reference streaming): dropped when >= 1.0 s of its frames have p >= 0.9; drops are reported per class
